requirements.text: Letter of Interest. A signed letter stating the firm's interest, the name of the attorney who would serve as lead coverage counsel, and the firm's agreement to the Authority's form of legal services agreement or a list of the changes it would ask for.
The Firm. The firm's size, structure and offices, the number of attorneys who practice insurance coverage law, and the firm's history of work for public entity risk pools.
Personnel. The names and qualifications of the lead coverage counsel and each other attorney proposed, the work each would do, and a statement of each attorney's current caseload.

Coverage Experience. A description of the firm's work in the last five years on coverage opinions, reservation of rights letters, coverage litigation and reinsurance disputes for public entity pools or insurers. Identify three written coverage opinions (with privileged content removed) that the Authority may ask to see.

Method of Service. How the firm would deliver coverage opinions within the Authority's standard of ten business days, how it would handle requests marked urgent, and how it would report to the Claims Committee each quarter.
Client References. Three references from risk pools or insurers, with the name and direct contact details of a person familiar with the firm's work.

Conflicts. A list of every member of the Authority that the firm has represented in the last five years, every matter in which the firm has acted for or against Stonebridge Claims Services, Inc. or Marlin Reach Reinsurance Company, and a statement of how any conflict would be handled. The list of members is in Appendix A.
Pricing. Hourly rates by attorney and paralegal; a proposed flat fee per written coverage opinion; and any annual cap the firm is willing to offer.
Additional Information. Anything else the firm wishes the Authority to consider, in no more than one page.

extra_fields.source_line / source_line_no: on each deadline: the line of the RFP file (stripped, 1-based number) that states the date in force. For a date changed by addendum it is the addendum line; original_source_line is the line in the body.
extra_fields.section, numbered, text: on each requirement: the section it sits in, whether the RFP gives it a number or label, and its exact text with runs of white space collapsed to one space (the label itself is left out).
extra_fields.alt_labels, alt_qtypes: other labels or question types that a scorer should also accept. Question types are the test author's judgement.
extra_fields.deleted_requirements: requirements removed by addendum. They must NOT appear in the parsed requirement list.
extra_fields.evaluation_as_issued, forms_as_issued, b: values before any addendum, for checking that the change is shown.
extra_fields.addendum (on addendum_changes): which addendum made the change. Kinds beyond the existing keys: requirement_deleted, criterion_removed, weight_changed, insurance_changed, form_removed; time_from and time_to are given where an addendum changes the time of day.
extra_fields.amount_value: insurance amount as a whole number of dollars.
extra_fields.dates_that_are_not_deadlines: dates in the text that must not be read as schedule deadlines.
extra_fields.not_requirements: numbered or lettered items that are not proposal requirements (scope of services, general conditions, table of contents). Reading them as requirements is an error.
extra_fields.kind_not_in_existing_keys: marks a deadline kind the existing keys do not use; score it separately.
